name: ZEDTRON
summary: The Zedtron Water Purifier is a premium domestic water purification system engineered to deliver clean, safe, and healthy drinking water for your family.

rows: Advanced RO Purification
Multi-stage RO purification technology effectively removes dissolved impurities, bacteria, viruses, heavy metals, and harmful chemicals for safe and pure drinking water.
Enhanced Water Quality
Improves the taste, odor, and clarity of water while retaining essential minerals for healthier hydration.
Suitable for Multiple Water Sources
Designed to work efficiently with borewell, municipal, and tanker water, making it ideal for various household water supplies.
High-Performance RO Membrane
Premium Thin Film Composite (TFC) membrane ensures efficient purification, high durability, and long-lasting performance.
Food-Grade Storage Tank
Built with high-quality food-grade materials to maintain hygiene and keep purified water fresh and safe.
Fully Automatic Operation
Automatically starts and stops purification based on the storage tank level, providing hassle-free operation.
Energy Efficient
Designed with low power consumption for reliable performance while reducing electricity costs.
Elegant & Compact Design
Sleek and space-saving cabinet design enhances the appearance of modern kitchens and homes.
Low Maintenance
High-quality filters and durable components reduce maintenance requirements and extend the product's lifespan.
Ideal for Everyday Use
Perfect for homes, apartments, offices, and small commercial spaces that require a dependable and continuous supply of purified drinking water.
